bundle.shortDescription: Which language models will actually run well on your machine
bundle.longDescription: WhatRunsHere measures the machine it runs on and works out, from each model's real architecture, which ones will fit and how fast they will be. Every answer is computed offline; the only thing it fetches is a model's weights, when you ask it to.
